hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if echo "$f" | grep -qE '(^|/)(fixtures|tests/golden)/|reference_metrics\.toml'; then echo 'Blocked: fixtures and goldens are protected by CLAUDE.md. Refresh goldens only via the sanctioned path (UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 cargo nextest run -p unlace-test-harness --features all-arches --test golden_fixtures golden_<name>, or cargo xtask regen-goldens) as a reviewed update -- never a hand edit. If this IS a reviewed fixture/golden task, regenerate through that path instead.' >&2; exit 2; fi
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.rs) rustfmt --edition 2024 "$f" 2>&1 || true ;; esac

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *crates/unlace-ir/*.rs|*crates/unlace-passes/*.rs|*crates/unlace-struct/*.rs|*crates/unlace-output/*.rs) out=$(cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && cargo xtask lint-determinism 2>&1) || { echo "$out" | grep -E 'FAIL|:[0-9]+:' >&2; echo 'determinism: justify with // determinism:allow <reason> or use BTreeMap/BTreeSet (see docs/determinism.md).' >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac
